title: Bring Split Labels at Points to Audacity 4
body:
### Problem to be solved

Reported by @vagnervideo on Audacity Forum:
https://forum.audacityteam.org/t/please-restore-file-labeled-audio-menu-in-audacity-4/153061

I noticed that Audacity 4 no longer has the “Edit / Labeled Audio” menu that was present in Audacity 3.x.

That is sorely missed! I used it a lot to automatically split at all the label points. (Menu Edit / Labeled Audio / Split)

### Your idea

Port it from audacity 3

### Prior art

Audacity 3

### Additional context

It was there, now it is gone
